subject: riotInterceptor
pitch:
Category: Vehicle.
Subject: corporate riot-control interceptor with a water cannon and neon light bars.
Style: Cyberpunk 2077.

spec.name: Riot Control Interceptor VX-9
spec.description: A hulking corporate riot-control hover-truck in Cyberpunk 2077 style: armored matte-black hull, roof water cannon turret, glowing neon light bars and emissive corporate branding.
spec.layout: A low, wide, wedge-nosed armored truck, 6.4 m long, standing on four big chunky wheels (no hover), with the floor at y=0. Front (+Z): angled armored bull-bar ram and slit headlights with a cyan light bar across the nose. Behind the nose, a raised cab with a sloped dark-glass windscreen, slit side windows and a roof light bar (red/blue neon). The rear half is a boxy armored prisoner/equipment bay with a rear door, vent grilles and hazard stripes. On the roof behind the cab sits a rotating water cannon turret: a squat ring base, a rotating pod and a long thick barrel pointing forward (+Z) with a nozzle ring, plus hoses and a tank on the rear deck. Wheels are tall, chunky and low-poly with hubs, tyres and arch armor. Style: matte charcoal plating with panel seams, yellow-black hazard chevrons, magenta and cyan neon strips along the skirts and wheel arches, corporate logo emblem (hex shape plus bars) glowing on doors, small warning lights, antennas and grilles. Everything is faceted and blocky, with neon as small emissive parts (glow kit) on top of the simple bases.

parts.builds: The lower armored hull and underbody: main slab chassis from nose wedge to tail, side skirts with magenta and cyan neon strips along the bottom edge, wheel-arch cutout armor (box frames and flared fenders over the four wheels), front bull-bar ram with hazard yellow-black chevrons, front bumper with slit cyan headlights and a neon cyan light bar across the nose, tow hooks, rear bumper with red tail light strips, underbody dark plating and exhaust-free skid plates, panel seams as thin dark strips. Mostly hull, hullDark and armor with small neon and hazard parts.
parts.attaches: Top face at chassisTop; cab starts at cabFloor and bay at bayFloor; wheels sit in the arches at axleFront and axleRear; rides joint body.

parts.builds: The raised front cab on the chassis between z=0.2 and z=2.6: sloped armored windscreen of dark glass with a glassGlow reflection strip, wipers, slit side windows with armored frames, A-pillars, roof panel with a roof light bar made of segmented neon red and neon blue lights and small warnOrange beacons, side mirrors with tiny neon lights, door seams with handles, a glowing corporate logo (hex plus bars in corpRed and white) on each door, front hood vents and small antenna masts with red tips. Interior hinted by a dark seat silhouette behind the glass.
parts.attaches: Sits on cabFloor atop chassis; rear wall meets the bay front at z=0.2; roof light bar at roofBar.

parts.builds: The boxy armored equipment/prisoner bay behind the cab from z=-3.1 to z=0.2: slab-sided box with panel seams and rivets, hazard yellow-black chevron stripes on the lower rear and the rear door, rear double door with handles and a small slit window, vent grilles on the sides with glowing red slits, a rear water tank and hose reels with coiled hoses (sweeps) on the rear deck, roof ribs, cyan neon trim lines along the upper edges, side-mounted corporate logo and 'RIOT' ID block in glowing white bars, rear tail lights, license plate with neon digits, antennas and a roof amber beacon at the back.
parts.attaches: Sits on bayFloor atop chassis; front wall meets the cab; turret ring at turretRing is left clear on its roof.

parts.builds: The roof water cannon: round base ring at turretRing with a toothed collar and cyan neon ring, rotating yaw pod (squat faceted drum with armor plates), a pitch cradle with side brackets and hydraulic pistons, a long thick barrel pointing +Z with reinforcement bands, hazard-striped sections, a flared nozzle ring at the muzzle with a glowing water-blue core and neon cyan accents, a supply hose arching from the bay tank into the pod, a small targeting camera/sensor with a red glowing lens and a warning light. Parts ride turretYaw and cannon joints so the barrel can swing.
parts.attaches: Base ring centred on turretRing atop the bay roof; barrel reaches barrelMuzzle; hose connects toward the bay tank at the rear.

parts.builds: Four chunky low-poly wheels at the axles: faceted dark tyres with tread block parts, metal rims with lug nuts and bolts, central hubs with a small glowing magenta or cyan neon ring on the outer face, brake discs and calipers (red), plus axle stubs and suspension arms (sweeps) up to the chassis, mud flaps with small hazard marks. Wheel radius about 0.55 m, width 0.5 m, floor contact at y=0. Each wheel rides its wheel joint.
parts.attaches: Centred on axleFront and axleRear at x = ±1.15, inside the chassis arches; rides wheelFL, wheelFR, wheelRL, wheelRR.
